title: A labor rate change prices billable work as before, internal work stays unpriced
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B with no labor rate of its own.
custom_steps:
1. Change the test location's labor rate to $150.00 an hour.
  2. Open work order 1.
  3. Create a new work order for customer B with a labor line of 2.0 hours.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rate is saved.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's labor line still shows 2.0 hours and no price: nothing is updated.

Step 3:

  • The new line shows Total $300.00 (2.0 h × $150.00).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-E1: “If a line is added to an internal or no-charge work order from a canned line, from an inspection or from ShopCoach, its prices are dropped on entry; cost and hours are kept. A labor rate change in settings has nothing to update on these work orders.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
